tone.voice: a passionate culture insider — energetic, never boring, always in the know

ux_norms: content is everything — UI recedes into the background
autoplay and continuous scroll are default behaviours
dark mode is the default and expected
thumbnail quality drives all click decisions
watch history and continue watching always visible
social sharing is a primary action

icons.style: bold filled, dark UI, high contrast

visual_language.style: high contrast, bold, visually dramatic — dark UI that lets content pop
photography_rules: content art and thumbnails are the primary visual
high contrast and vibrant colour grading
creator photos should feel authentic not polished
visual_language.background_treatment: dark — near black or pure black — always. Content provides the colour.
visual_language.empty_state_style: bold SVG — play button, headphones, or camera with energetic copy
visual_language.onboarding_visual: bold graphic vector or cinematic still — high energy
visual_language.illustration_style: when used: bold graphic vector — high contrast, expressive

compliance_notes: COPPA for platforms accessible to minors
GDPR for viewing data and preferences

avoid: Never auto-play with sound — always muted by default in browse context
Never show spoilers in thumbnails or previews without a spoiler warning toggle
Never interrupt playback with subscription prompts mid-content
Never use fake view counts or engagement metrics
Never show content recommendations that ignore the user's viewing history after 5+ watched items
Never use a content rating without showing what it means
enforce: Content rating always visible before playback begins
Parental controls always available and easy to set
Creator credit always visible on content
Download option visible on every content item in paid tier
Skip intro/credits always offered after first episode

Social & Community.headline: Share what you love. Find your people.
